title: Frontend: Flatten Nested Array
businessContext: Build and verify the core behavior behind Flatten Nested Array. This independently authored exercise has a bounded, explicit contract. Injected clock, network, random, or worker models are identified in the contract; they do not claim production service guarantees.
problemStatement: Implement solution(values). Flatten nested JSON arrays in left-to-right order. Objects/null are leaves. Inputs are acyclic and may be deeply nested; do not mutate them.
constraints: Define solution(input) in plain JavaScript. Return the documented JSON-compatible value or throw the documented validation error. Each case receives a fresh input.
Preserve identity, ordering, boundary behavior, and error messages stated in the contract. Passing fixtures verifies this contract, not every production concern.
candidateTasks: Implement the documented behavior without hard-coding fixture answers.
Run the full suite, investigate boundary failures, and explain the follow-up variation.
hints: Write down the state or algorithmic invariant, and trace the smallest boundary case before coding.
Walk each element: recurse or push explicit stack frames for arrays and append non-array leaves.
alternativeApproaches: Support a maximum flattening depth and compare path-cycle detection with global deduplication.
commonMistakes: Ignoring contract boundaries such as: Empty arrays; nested empties; non-array objects.
Treating a local deterministic model as proof of durable storage, authorization, distributed coordination, or physical-world guarantees.
